steps.content: This huge half of the Corpus collapses and dissolves to dust, severing the link between the living and dead halves. The Corpseborne lets out an angry roar, but then slowly leaves the mine.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, I did it! I can fight alongside you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah, thank you. You were a huge help.
The shackles fade away, too. Soon, you won't be able to hear each other, but Hecate has never felt so at ease.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I still have some work to do. I'll finish it soon. Stay with your new friends and wait for me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When I'm done, I'll come pick you up right away.
You see the raging Corpseborne in front of you. It can no longer hide its body. A huge monster with half a body glares down at you.
